The '''''Javelin''''' was a model of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in use around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. When the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] began forming a new [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]] in [[41 ABY]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] began ambushing and [[Pirate/Legends|capturing]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] for use in their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. By [[44 ABY]], there were at least half a dozen ''Javelins'' in use in the Sith fleet. Six ''Javelins'' traveled to [[Pydyr]] as reinforcements for the Sith there, and they engaged in [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|battle]] with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] wing of [[StealthX]]s.
